scene: The conductor deposits you at Harbor Central transit hub.
picture: Along a wide stone platform, an open subway stairwell sits far left. The friendly robot conductor stands left next to the player, who wears her yellow raincoat and green boots while holding her red umbrella at centre. A yellow street tram waits far right, while a red cable car hangs up high.
shown: A red cable car hanging up high on a thick steel line
An open glowing stairwell leading down to subway platforms on far left
A yellow street tram waiting with open doors on the far right

variants.scene: The friendly robot conductor waves goodbye as you step onto the bustling platform.
Salty ocean air sweeps across the harbor platform under the dusky purple sky.
You pause on the stone platform, humming {tune} above the humming machinery.
